sum: PMA Graphene Technology Group Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in wet trades works in Hong Kong. Its works include plastering, tile laying, brick laying, floor screeding, and marble works, as well as small-scale fitting out services, such as renovation works. The company also trades in wines and spirits. It primarily serves construction contractors in public and private sectors. The company was formerly known as Ming Shing Group Holdings Limited and changed its name to PMA Graphene Technology Group Inc. in August 2026. The company was incorporated in 2022 and is based in Cheung Sha Wan, Hong Kong.
